learning_action: Tap the lesson hotspot to reveal the related 3D model and instructional caption.
requirement_text: In the AR lesson scene, let the learner tap a designated hotspot to reveal a pre-positioned 3D model and its short instructional caption. Keep the model hidden until the hotspot is tapped. The AR camera, hotspot collider, model root, and caption UI are assigned in the Inspector.

learning_action: Navigate a staged anatomy lesson, viewing one model and its caption at a time.
requirement_text: Guide learners through a sequence of four AR anatomy stages. Each stage has its own model root and caption. Show only the active stage, display its position in the sequence, and let the learner move backward or forward using UI buttons connected to the public navigation methods. Keep navigation within the first and last stages.
